regulations.enforcement_body: City of New Orleans / One Stop Shop
regulations.notes: New Orleans has strict STR regulations enacted in 2019 and updated since. Residential STRs (owner-occupied, limited use) require a permit and the owner must be present. Commercial STRs are restricted to commercial zones. Whole-home non-owner-occupied STRs in residential areas are generally prohibited. Violations carry significant fines.
